comparison.interval: 95% Wilson descriptive intervals for seed-level failure rates under declared random initialization; not confirmatory and not adjusted for multiple arms
comparison.paired: discordant seed counts versus baseline; no independent-row p values
comparison.primary: any exact collapse across rho<1; denominator 100 seeds
comparison.secondary: any joint optimization gap >0.01 across rho<1
comparison.selection: none; report all arms; no automatic promotion
comparison.stop: complete fixed schedule; retain errors; no replacement seeds, extra candidates or restarts

grid.scope: controlled slice; common exact initial kernels for every arm; R3 initialization override makes it identical to baseline here

design.scope: known finite task optimization, not sampled-data generalization
